[[Master's Salvage Kit]] is a [[salvage kit]] with 25 uses. It offers the same effectiveness as either the [[Silver-Fed Salvage-o-Matic]] or the [[Mystic Salvage Kit]].

== Acquisition ==
* Any [[merchant]] or [[Master craftsman]] for {{coin|1536}}
* [[Zephyrite merchant]]s for {{coin|800}} and {{token|geode|10}}
* Sold by the following for karma:
{{Vendor query table|item=Master's Salvage Kit|currency=karma}}

== Used in ==
Each of the recipes below requires a full-charged kit, i.e. 25 remaining uses.
{{recipe list}}

== Trivia ==
* Before October 2012, [[Master Weaponsmith]]s sold these items, as well as others, for karma.
